episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Lee Han-young, a former corrupt judge, comes to his senses after presiding over a trial involving Gojin Chemical.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Lee is assassinated but miraculously travels back in time, determined to right his wrongs.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Lee seeks to correct the sentencing errors he made in the past and is determined to avoid similar mistakes.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Seoul presents a hidden advantage to Lee and he forms an alliance with Prosecutor Kim Jin-a.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A step closer to finding his killer, Lee makes a bold decision and pledges false allegiance to Kang Sin-jin.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Judge Lee obtains incriminating evidence of Woo and continues to expand his influence.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Judge Lee continues to gain Kang Sin-jin's trust, while discovering more corruption.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Kang is wary of Lee and sets out to test his loyalty.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Lee and his allies devise a plan to intercept Kang's hidden funds but meet with an unexpected obstacle.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Judge Lee and Kang Sin-jin begin to disagree, and Kang reveals a shocking truth to Lee.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Judge Lee continues his partnership with Kang and secretly plots to take down a greater evil.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: As Judge Lee's plans begin to materialize, Kang continues to seize more control.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Judge Lee reveals his true identity to Kang Sin-jin, but the worst is yet to come.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Han-young, falsely accused of murder and pursued by the police just like in his previous life, embarks on a final operation to clear his name and bring Shin-jin to justice.
